tests.mode: isolated evidence recording; no baseline comparisons

images.title: Welcome · live simulator
images.note: The video gives the app personality. Its embedded playback text can sit behind the description in some frames.

images.title: Location prompt · live simulator
images.note: The notch, status bar, home indicator and four-tab navigation fit. Both location choices remain visible.

images.title: Welcome · native fixture
images.note: Readable title and generous Continue button. Offer a shortcut to location selection.

images.title: Prediction introduction
images.note: A real chart preview explains the product; this is the second page before the user chooses a place.

images.title: Satellite categories
images.note: Strong photography and clear category rows. These isolated fixtures omit the station cards and tab bar.

images.title: Satellite list
images.note: The one-item fixture reveals dense metadata. Prioritize name and observing information; move historical metadata into details.

images.title: Station pass forecast
images.note: Globe and repeated circular previews look good but use substantial vertical space.

images.title: Pass detail · compass off
images.note: The full chart is clear without the guidance overlay. Technical azimuth and elevation data can be secondary.

images.title: Pass detail · compass on
images.note: The orientation instruction overlays the central sky chart. The eye control has no visible text label.

images.title: Expanded chart
images.note: An enlarged crop makes the stars readable. The still image does not establish pan/zoom behavior.

images.title: Sky now · loading fixture
images.note: Loading state only. The fixture has not settled its live sky; this is not evidence of a production blank-screen defect.

images.title: Settings
images.note: Location, alarms and data are grouped clearly. The large blank top area may reflect unresolved map content; investigate live before treating it as a layout bug.

images.title: Location chooser · idle
images.note: The search prompt says Enter address. A city-oriented prompt would better match the home action Choose a city.

images.title: Alarms · empty
images.note: The empty state explains the bell path, but offers no direct route to find a pass. Edit appears even with no alarms.

images.title: Alarm creation
images.note: View alarm appears above an unscheduled Schedule alarm action. Four technical timing choices and a seconds wheel complicate a common task.

images.title: Orbital data · empty
images.note: Ephemerides is specialist vocabulary. Keep it in advanced settings with a plain-language explanation.

images.title: 3D pass preview
images.note: The immersive horizon is a highlight. A star label is visible through the upper-right control. Motion unavailable is expected on a simulator.

images.title: Home · no visible passes
images.note: The message distinguishes a real empty forecast from an error and offers two recovery paths.

images.title: Home · upcoming pass
images.note: The next observation is visually dominant. The prominent Remind me action enables station alerts, rather than scheduling this specific pass.

images.title: Home · accessibility text
images.note: Text wraps rather than truncates. The reminder row is large and Coming up moves below the fold; scrolling is expected.

images.title: Home · weather
images.note: Weather fits beside the location. The current-weather badge can be mistaken for conditions at the future pass time.

images.title: Home · weather + accessibility text
images.note: Weather correctly moves to its own row. The reminder action extends below the first viewport and needs a scroll.

images.title: Home · no location fixture
images.note: Example is explicitly labeled and both location choices fit. The live capture includes the actual system chrome.

images.title: Path animation · early
images.note: An isolated rendering fixture at 20% playback, not a full app screen.

images.title: Path animation · late
images.note: An isolated rendering fixture at 82% playback. Solid/dotted path states carry meaning that merits a small legend.

images.title: Sky preview · twilight
images.note: The purple horizon adds depth. This is an isolated sky component, not a full screen.

images.title: Home · scrolled with tabs
images.note: The floating navigation remains readable. Compare All passes and reminder affordances in a full tab context.

images.title: Pass list · scrolled with tabs
images.note: Large circular thumbnails yield about two complete pass rows in this viewport. The third continues behind the floating tabs.

images.title: Satellites · scrolled with tabs
images.note: Station cards and category photos look cohesive; a compact summary would make scan-and-compare easier.
